products.name: Gazelle Armchair
products.summary: The horseshoe armchair. Fifty-one parts from Titobi's shop file, each laminated along its own axis, joined with loose tenons and dowels and pinned with brass fittings.
products.description_html:
The horseshoe armchair. Fifty-one parts from Titobi's shop file, each laminated along its own axis, joined with loose tenons and dowels and pinned with brass fittings.

In Baltic Birch, every part is CNC-cut from 18 mm plies laminated in pairs, and each ply gets a 5/8" roundover, so the ply stripes run along every member.

Available in Baltic Birch, Walnut, White Oak, Wenge and Maple.

  • Dimensions: 22.8 × 21.4 × 31.0 in (580 × 544 × 788 mm), W × D × H
  • Seat height: 18.2 in (462 mm)
  • Arm height: 26.6 in (676 mm)
  • Finishes: Baltic Birch, Walnut, White Oak, Wenge, Maple
  • Baltic Birch: 18 mm plies laminated in pairs, 5/8" roundover on each ply

Designed by Titobi Studios, a collaboration of Norman Teague Design Studios and Max Davis Design in Chicago.
